display_long_description:
HomecareVR is an immersive educational VR experience designed to help older adults and caregivers learn practical home safety skills in a supportive and interactive environment. Through guided simulations, users explore everyday home scenarios and practice identifying potential hazards, improving mobility awareness, and building confidence in navigating familiar spaces.

Featuring an AI-powered voice-interactive guide, HomecareVR offers clear spoken instructions, situational guidance, and personalized feedback to keep training sessions engaging and accessible for all experience levels.

🗣️ Natural Voice Interaction

Speak directly with the virtual guide to receive tips, instructions, and step-by-step assistance as you move through each activity.

🏠 Realistic Home Simulations

Walk through lifelike virtual rooms that mirror common household environments. Learn how to spot obstacles, avoid slips or trips, and safely interact with everyday objects.

🎯 Personalized Training Experience

The AI guide adjusts its prompts and feedback based on how the user moves and responds, helping create a supportive learning experience tailored to individual comfort and pace.
